Subject: Fwd: DPA + SCCs for Helios Health pilot — internal comments

Forwarding Logan's thread. I reviewed Helios' counter and attached a marked-up draft (Marissa_comments_redline.docx). Principal items:
1) Data residency: we can commit to US-only processing for the pilot but need clear scope (project/tenant IDs). Recommend a limited geography addendum rather than changing core clause.
2) Liability / caps: Helios proposes removal of the cap for breach-related statutory fines. We should push back and offer a carve for indemnity for IP/regulated-data incidents up to a higher custom cap with exec approval.
3) SCCs: Helios is asking us to accept their SCCs addendum. We can accept standard EU SCCs when required, but verify which SCCs template they mean. For US customers often they supply a special data processing addendum — ask them to point to exact doc.
4) SOC 2 & evidence: we can provide the report under NDA + a short evidence bundle for encryption, key rotation, logging retention. Karthik will produce the bundle and a mapping table.

Signer routing: if Helios needs countersignature speed, propose this flow: (1) Helios signs, (2) Redwood Legal (me) reviews final redline, (3) Redwood GC signs. If Helios insists Redwood sign first, escalate to Neha for exec exception (re: liability cap).

Logan — please confirm the tenant/region scope for the pilot and ask Aisha to upload Helios' exact SCCs doc if they have one.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Logan / Marissa —

We reviewed Redwood's redline. A few high-priority asks from Legal: 
- SCCs: Helios requires we execute our SCC Addendum (attached to our counter). Please confirm Redwood can accept Helios SCC Addendum or propose mapping.
- Data residency: Helios needs a clause that all pilot data for this engagement remains physically stored in US-east regions (we provided a short scope appendix).
- Liability: we cannot accept broad liability caps for regulatory fines tied to mishandling of PHI-like data. We propose a carve-out for statutory fines and regulatory penalties.
- Evidence: please provide SOC 2 Type II (most recent) and the SIG matrix items for encryption, KMS, and logging. We will accept an NDA-protected link.

Timing: to keep the procurement timeline, can Redwood provide the SOC2 + SIG bundle within 48 hours and confirm a signing path by EOD tomorrow? If Redwood needs exec approval for the liability carve, please flag now and we can await a final countersignature.

Attaching our counter for ease (as before): Helios_DPA_counter_v2.docx

Regards,
Aisha Patel
Head of Procurement, Helios Health
